notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS w/ interactive query assistant + support bot proof-of-value. Trial started on hosted API; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Hosted trial results (observed):
- Baseline QPS: 10-14 steady across business hours (EU+NA), typical weekday patterns.
- Peak QPS observed during feature release: ~48 QPS for 12m window.
- Avg concurrency per region: 5-8 active streams (chat sessions) with spikes to 18 during rollouts.
- Token mix (by volume): prompt ~60%, completion ~40% (prompt avg ~110 tokens, completion avg ~220 tokens).
- Monthly token burn (approx during trial month): 120M input tokens, 80M output tokens -> total ~200M tokens.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency on hosted trial ~420ms (prompt len 100-150, model: open-llama-family).

POC objectives:
- Move from Hosted -> Dedicated to guarantee 99th percentile latency <500ms under production QPS, and to meet compliance (VPC + audit logs).
- Reduce per-token unit cost via batching + KV caching for repeated analytic queries.
- Support model routing: primary open model + fallback to smaller quantized variant when latency spikes.

Capacity sizing inputs requested from customer:
- Target sustained QPS (prod): 20 QPS avg global, peak 70 QPS with regional fan-out.
- Target concurrency for chat sessions: 25 concurrent sessions per region during peaks.
- Token profile expected to grow 2.2x in 6 months due to feature launch.
- SLA needed: 99.9% uptime; <600ms p95 lat for typical conversation turns.

Redwood-specific asks / notes:
- Customer requests an initial Dedicated sizing worksheet: GPUs required, expected concurrency per GPU, projected token throughput and cost delta vs hosted.
- Wants model quantization recommendation to achieve cost target without >3% quality regression (use Optimize suggestions).
- Networking: needs clear peering path and estimated lead time (security requires PrivateLink/VPC peering).

Commercial / pricing conversations:
- Customer is cost-sensitive but values predictable bills. Looking at $150k-$350k ARR commit to start (12-month reserved capacity).
- Wants a two-tiered proposal: base reserved capacity + burst credits. Interested in metered vs committed unit economics comparison.

Quotes / direct feedback: "We liked the hosted trial speed and the SDKs — but we need guaranteed tail latency when we ship the analytics assistant to all customers."

Next steps (short):
- Workshop (scheduled 2026-03-03) to validate traffic forecast and run Dedicated sizing worksheet with SE Diego.
- Deliver Dedicated pricing proposal and a recommended cluster config (GPU types, target concurrency, autoscale thresholds) by 2026-03-10.
- Security to start network peering checklist; request: anticipated peering completion window (30-45 days).

Open blockers: cost alignment (internal finance signoff), network peering timeline, final SLA terms (legal).
